tagline: A Moore Town sustainable education framework for community – by community
vision: Empower young people in Moore Town and the upper Rio Grande Valley to access and complete quality education and skills training, supported by community-led funding and mentorship to enable beneficiaries to meaningfully contribute to community and nation building.
mission: To support young people in building brighter futures through learning, guidance, and community support.

launchInfo.occasion: Memorial service of Viola Minott (Miss Addie)
launchInfo.initiative: Bringing the H.E.A.T. (Health, Education, Agriculture, and Tourism) to Portland

keyPrinciples.title: Dignity over charity
keyPrinciples.description: Fostering respect, self-determination, and mutual elevation rather than transactional hand-outs.

keyPrinciples.title: Equity over competition
keyPrinciples.description: Prioritizing support based on unique personal and household barriers over purely academic contest.

keyPrinciples.title: Mentorship is just as important as money
keyPrinciples.description: Pairing every financial disbursement with active role-model engagement and personal guidance.

keyPrinciples.title: Community ownership
keyPrinciples.description: Rooted in the leadership, traditions, and direct participation of the Rio Grande Valley community.

keyPrinciples.title: Transparency and accountability
keyPrinciples.description: Clear governance, published outcomes, and open stewardship of all community contributions.

keyPrinciples.title: Learning and adaptation
keyPrinciples.description: Continually evolving the framework through learner feedback and reflection.
